_readme: Single source of truth for the store. Read by the browser (assets/js/naga-store.js) and by the server (api/preorder.js). Prices are per unit. Leave a key empty to switch that feature off; the site falls back gracefully. Secrets never go here: the Shopify Admin token and webhook URL are Vercel environment variables.

sipag-i.name: SIPAG I
sipag-i._note: Price is still a placeholder. While priceConfirmed is false, the price stays out of structured data (scripts/seo.js).

diwa.name: DIWA
diwa._note: No price yet: reservations only, no payment.

zones.label: Oceania, South Asia and the Middle East

shipping._note: Lead times are estimates from dispatch in Manila until delivery. Confirm the zones and days with DHL.

shopify._note: storeDomain like naga-industries.myshopify.com. The Storefront token is public by design. Put each product's variant GID (gid://shopify/ProductVariant/...) in shopifyVariantId above.

crypto._note: recipient is Naga's Solana wallet that receives USDC. Use a dedicated RPC (Helius, QuickNode) for rpcUrl in production; the public endpoint is rate-limited.
